summary: Gravel car park beside the pool and tennis courts; no homes near.
reasons: Park, pool and courts all round
Gravel lot with cars parked in it

best_section.where: Gravel car park south-east of the ring, between the swimming pool and the tennis centre clubhouse

drivers.seclusion: Nearest buildings are the pool, courts, halls and clubs; only non-residential buildings mapped.
drivers.access_and_room: Gravel and dirt surface with cars parked on it, reached by a sealed driveway; room for a van.
drivers.traffic: Inside the park, off the main roads; quiet at night.
drivers.convention: Cars use it by day; no campers seen.

flags: Steep: DEM shows about 10% mean grade at the ring, which sits on a path; the car park looks flat
Mapped gate 22 m away, not on the only access
Park and pool users and staff may notice a van
sun_shade: Trees shade the west and east edges; open to midday sun.
cannot_judge: Whether the car park is for pool or tennis users only
